snapshot.kind: Read-only stable complete-line prefixes; retain latest20consecutive completed summary rows and matching strict training-program events; no dataset or weight files read
snapshot.selection: Latest20complete summary lines by log order, with matching journal promotions; no outcome-based selection

selection: All complete consecutive summary rounds; journal kind=promotion in that window
rate_scope: Retained completed rounds; logged wall time includes qualification waits; not deployment throughput

metric_definition.program_promotions: Strict training-program incumbent events, checked against summary counts
metric_definition.cumulative_program_promotions: Running sum within this window only; starts from zero
metric_definition.completed_round_wall_seconds: summary.wall_seconds; rates divide total completed rounds or strict program promotions by their summed wall time
metric_definition.reported_best_round: adapter_admission.best_round; a logged identity, not the first strict increase in utility

source_binding: Field interpretation only; installed run source/checkpoint qualification remains required
scope: Development telemetry only; no sealed data or independent first-proposal comparison

figure_definition.a: logged candidate and recorded-best validation pool utility (best labeled round 882) with paired utility shortfall shaded
figure_definition.b: per-round and cumulative strict training-program incumbent events (15 total; reset to zero for this window)
figure_definition.c: completed rounds per hour over accumulated completed-round wall time (41.58/hr whole-window rate)
figure_definition.d: strict training-program incumbent events per hour over accumulated completed-round wall time (31.19/hr whole-window rate)
